description: Implementation of a network loopback interface for Zephyr OS, including initialization, packet handling, and optional packet drop simulation.

methods.name: loopback_dev_init
methods.description: Initializes the loopback device, currently a no-op.

methods.name: loopback_init
methods.description: Initializes the network interface with link address and optional IPv4/IPv6 loopback addresses.

methods.name: loopback_set_packet_drop_ratio
methods.description: Sets the ratio of packets to drop for simulation purposes.

methods.name: loopback_get_num_dropped_packets
methods.description: Returns the number of packets dropped during simulation.

methods.name: loopback_send
methods.description: Handles sending a packet by cloning, swapping IP addresses, and passing it to the network stack.
